WHY THIS MATTERS NOW

Parents are searching for AI help right now

Families hear about AI every week and feel behind. They type real questions into Google, Amazon, YouTube, and Instagram: Is ChatGPT safe for my kid? How do I use it for homework help? Chat and Suzanne already holds the answers — a 5.0-star book, a YouTube channel, and a warm, teacher-trained voice. The window is open now, before bigger and colder brands take those search spots.

  • Parents use Instagram like a search bar. Posts with clear, plain keywords get found. Posts without them disappear.
  • A 5.0-star book is proof. Right now that proof sits where almost no shopper looks. Every post should point back to it.
  • YouTube (@ChatGPTandSuzanne) is a second front door. Short, friendly videos of Suzanne can carry the same lessons to families who would rather watch than read.

THE 7-DAY PLAYBOOK

One week, one lap.

Day 1Rewrite the Instagram bio in plain words: who Suzanne helps, the book's full title, and one link. Say '5.0 stars on Amazon' in the bio.
Day 2Pin three posts to the top of @suzfeit: the book intro, one A-to-Z sample adventure, and the 5.0-star proof. New visitors should understand the brand in five seconds.
Day 3Publish Posts #1 and #2. Reply to every comment the same day. Ask one question in each caption so parents have a reason to answer.
Day 4Record one 60-second video of Suzanne: 'One ChatGPT question to ask your kids tonight.' Post it as a Reel on @suzfeit and upload it to YouTube @ChatGPTandSuzanne.
Day 5Connect every door: Facebook, LinkedIn, and YouTube should each name the book and link to its Amazon page. Same short message everywhere.
Day 6Start a simple 'Letter of the Week' email from chatandsuzanne@gmail.com — one family prompt per week, free. Collect sign-ups in the Instagram bio.
Day 7Review the week: count saves, shares, profile visits, and new followers. Do more of whatever moved. Repeat the cycle with the next letter.
